Strategy: Small-item worst fit: when the item is at most half the smallest feasible residual, score by largest residual, otherwise by tightest fit; small items are spread into roomy bins so tight bins stay free for large items that need them. It can fail when small items keep arriving and the roomy bins fragment into unusable pieces.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = min(bins)
    return [(r if item * 2 <= m else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
